results.evidence: Only ONE published coordinate for the West Peak-Cashmere col was found: the peak list's key-saddle point for the west peak ('Mohair Mountain', 8,281 ft LiDAR; saddle 7,977 ft LiDAR) at 47.55891,-120.85206. Owner option: accept the single published saddle coordinate (corroborated by the track) and apply proposed_pin_ops.

results.evidence: Waypoint 5 'Walrus (Clark) Glacier rope-up / crevasse zone' (48.04725024,-120.96234512, elev 7,000) reads 8,025 ft on USGS 3DEP and is 0.55 km ESE of the summit; ground around it is 7,800-8,150 ft, i.e. it sits high on the upper glacier / eastern arm, not at the rope-up. Published accounts put the rope-up at a ~6,700-6,760 ft bench on Clark's eastern arm (one report says ~7,000 ft), but none publishes a coordinate for it; the only published glacier coordinates (USGS name record 48.04902,-120.95900 and the encyclopedia's identical 48.04889,-120.95889) are label points for the whole glacier, not the toe, and computing a toe point from the mapped glacier outline is not allowed. The pin is NOT demonstrably off the route: it lies 111 m from the row's own 800-point track, which runs up the glacier to the summit (the upper line passes an ~8,000 ft col before the summit rocks), so removal is not permitted. No move (no published rope-up coordinate), no removal (on-route). The defect is the label/height, not a removable pin; owner option is a text edit making it the upper-glacier / crevasse-zone pin (~8,000 ft) rather than the rope-up.

The row climbs the SOUTH Peak (face, fa, beta and the pin name all say so). Two independent published coordinates for Hozomeen Mountain-South Peak agree within 28 m: the peak database's LiDAR summit 48.972745,-120.997915 (8,016 ft NAVD88) and the peak list's 48.9729,-120.9976 (8,003 ft). USGS 3DEP reads 8,056 ft at the LiDAR point (the 1/3-arc-second cell on a summit), versus 7,614 ft at the stored pin 48.97196,-120.99643, which is 139 m ESE of the summit on the steep face. The USGS name record and the map's peak node for 'Hozomeen Mountain' (48.98223,-121.01190 / 48.98208,-121.01207) are the higher NORTH peak, ~1.5 km away, which this row does not climb. Pin moved to the LiDAR summit point (the one 3DEP confirms); its stored elevation (8,003, matching the row's prose) is left as is. Pin name/note unchanged.

sources: USGS 3DEP point query: 8,056 ft at the new point vs 7,614 ft at the old (confirmation only)

results.evidence: Only WA row: wa_bald_eagle_peak_scramble (the other 'Bald Eagle' rows are CA/WI/CO/AR/RI crags). Summit pin 47.61686,-121.27162 matches the USGS name record for Bald Eagle Peak (47.616867,-121.271638) to ~2 m - correct. Trailhead pins 0-1 read 1,547/1,616 ft on 3DEP against 1,550/1,620 claimed - correct. Pins 2-4 have averaged (computed-looking) coordinates and sit EAST/SOUTHEAST of the summit (pin 2 410 m ESE at 5,220 ft vs 5,267 claimed; pin 3 273 m E at 4,943 ft vs 5,400 claimed; pin 4 68 m E at 6,032 ft vs 6,100 claimed), whereas the DEM puts the north-ridge crest along ~-121.276 north of the summit. But published route descriptions say the line leaves the ridge to the SE (left) at ~5,400 ft and makes a long rising traverse across the north-facing slopes into the upper basin before regaining the crest at ~6,100 ft, which is east of the crest - so the pins are not demonstrably off the route, only imprecise (pin 3 457 ft low). No published coordinate exists for the viewpoint, the bypass gully or the regain point, and the row has no track to test against. No move, no removal.

Per the instruction, the Longs/Goat Pass pins (south approach), the Stuart Glacier Crossing and North Ridge Base pins are KEPT; only pins with two agreeing published coordinates are moved. (1) Summit pin 'Mount Stuart Summit' 47.475,-120.904 reads 8,870 ft on USGS 3DEP - 545 ft below the summit, ~125 m W on the west flank. Three published coordinates agree within 30 m: the USGS name record 47.475016,-120.902243, the peak list 47.47514,-120.90238 (9,418 ft LiDAR), and the OpenStreetMap peak node 47.4751496,-120.901993; 3DEP reads 9,416 ft at the peak list's point, which is used. (2) 'Longs Pass' 47.444,-120.924 is 590 m S of the named pass; the USGS name record (47.44929,-120.92510) and the OpenStreetMap saddle node (47.4492393,-120.925414, carrying the same USGS feature id) agree within 24 m; 3DEP 6,223 ft at the USGS point. Moved to the USGS point. NOT changed: 'Goat Pass' 47.456,-120.913 reads 5,041 ft (Ingalls Creek valley) against 7,600 claimed - the pass is on Stuart's northwest ridge at ~7,650 ft, but no published coordinate for Goat Pass was found (no USGS name record, no map node), and the point lies on the Ingalls Creek leg of the south approach, so it is neither movable nor removable. 'Great Gendarme' 47.475,-120.908 (8,441 ft ground vs 9,000 claimed, 300 m W of the summit rather than on the north ridge) - no published coordinate; left. Elevations on the moved pins left unchanged (9,415 / 6,300).
